description: Read the latest retained scheduled-review findings and evidence without rescanning, or poll a specific run by requestId. An empty result before the first successful run is not a clean scan. No longer detected, ignored and already filed are not proof that an issue was fixed.

context.description: One sentence on why you are calling this tool, for OverlayQA product analytics. Describe the purpose only (for example "checking the checkout page for contrast issues"). Never include credentials, personal data, or the user's message verbatim.

requestId.description: Optional run request ID to read that run without starting another scan

name: get_scheduled_review_result
